arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Posner argued the insurer's profit motive should not affect the review.
Mr. Rosenkranz argued the Court should keep its prior unanimous ruling.
Ms. Saharsky argued the Court must consider the conflict of interest.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests how courts review insurer claim denials. One side argues profit motives must influence the review. The other side argues the conflict is irrelevant to the legal standard.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: The insurer wants a neutral review standard that ignores its profit motive.
The claimant wants a stricter review standard that weighs the insurer's profit motive.
